title: Signed operation ledger domain (backend-runtime-v1 / lp-ye4.5)
description: Authoritative shapes for multiplayer signed operation history, actor identity, and current-head materialization. Operation ids and history heads are SEPARATE from DocumentRevision (vault content CAS). Additive Brain RPC history/head methods (phase 3+) must not replace vault.write CAS or write_checkpoint policy. Phase 1 defines schemas, fixtures, and shared types only — no durable host store and no new RPC methods.
$comment: Bead lp-ye4.5 / epic lp-ye4. Compatible with brain-rpc documentRevision and vault.write modes (create_new, replace_if_match, replace_if_absent, write_checkpoint).

schemaVersion.description: Signed-operation domain schema major. Bump only with breaking shape changes.

operationId.description: Stable unique id for one ledger event. Prefixed op_. NEVER equal to DocumentRevision.token and never used as vault.write CAS token.

vaultPath.description: Vault-root-relative absolute path starting with /. Same path form as vault.write path / source_path.

isoDateTime.description: RFC3339 / ISO-8601 timestamp. Prefer UTC with Z.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest (no sha256: prefix).

documentRevisionKind.description: Mirrors brain-rpc documentRevisionKind. Production Office writeback prefers etag|content_hash|host_revision.

documentRevision.description: Host-owned identity of specific bytes at a vault path. Wire-compatible with brain-rpc $defs/documentRevision. Used for vault.write CAS and Office document.key material. Opaque token — never a file body. Distinct from operation_id.

token.description: Opaque revision token (e.g. sha256:… with kind content_hash, strong etag, or host UUID).

size_bytes.description: Content length at this revision when known.

modified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for UI only — never sole CAS key.

bodyHash.description: Cryptographic fingerprint of the written body bytes for this operation. Independent of DocumentRevision.token formatting (even when revision.kind is content_hash). Null body ops omit this field entirely (delete, pure reject without body).

alg.description: Hash algorithm. v1 only supports sha256.

size_bytes.description: Decoded byte length of the hashed body when known.

actorKind.description: Who initiated the observed commit or rejection. human = Portal user (Office callback / human write UI). agent = backend agent tool subject. system = host-internal maintenance. delegated_agent = agent run acting under a human or parent agent grant (phase 5).

actor.description: Safe actor provenance stored on ledger events. Never secrets, raw tokens, or browser-supplied ACL claims. Phase 5 binds grants; phase 1 freezes identity fields.

subject_id.description: Stable subject id for this actor kind (portal user id, agent id, system, or run subject).

display_name.description: Optional UI label. Not authoritative for ACL.

portal_user_id.description: Portal end-user id when kind is human or when a human delegated the run.

agent_id.description: Agent product/instance subject when kind is agent or delegated_agent.

run_id.description: Agent run / tool-call correlation id when kind is delegated_agent or agent.

session_id.description: Portal or Office session id when known (audit only).

backend_profile.description: Backend profile name stamped by BFF (admin, contributor, …).

grant_id.description: Optional access-grant id (phase 5). Omitted until grants exist.

operationTargetScope.description: file = single vault path. workspace = tree/workspace-level event (rare; most tree advances are side effects of file ops).

operationTarget.description: What the operation attempted to mutate. Path is always present for v1 (workspace events use workspace root path or logical workspace path).

path.description: Primary path: write destination for file ops; checkpoint destination for file_checkpoint; workspace root or logical path for workspace scope.

source_path.description: Canonical vault path when kind is file_checkpoint (mirrors vault.write source_path). Must differ from path.

workspace_id.description: Workspace partition when multi-workspace is enabled. Default workspace may omit or use 'default'.

operationKind.description: Ledger operation kind. Maps from vault.write modes: create_new→file_create; replace_if_match→file_replace; replace_if_absent→file_create|file_replace by outcome; write_checkpoint→file_checkpoint. CAS/policy failures → operation_rejected without advancing heads. workspace_tree_advance records explicit tree-only mutations or is used as a derived label when fixtures document tree root advance (phase 2 materializes heads from committed file ops).

vaultWriteMode.description: Mirrors brain-rpc vaultWriteMode. Present when the ledger event was produced by vault.write.

operationResultStatus.description: committed advances heads (when applicable). rejected is append-only audit of a failed attempt and MUST NOT advance artifact or workspace heads.

operationResultReason.description: Machine reason. Aligns with vault.write conflict details.reason and error codes where applicable.

operationResult.description: Outcome of the attempted mutation. On committed file writes, revision is the new DocumentRevision (CAS-compatible). On rejected, optional prior/actual revision tokens explain the conflict without claiming a new head.

revision.description: New host revision after durable commit. Required when status=committed and kind is a file body write. Absent on pure reject / tree-only labels that do not change file bytes.

prior_revision.description: Revision observed before the attempt (expected base for CAS).

actual_revision.description: Host current revision when status=rejected for revision_mismatch.

created.description: True when the path was newly created.

idempotent_replay.description: True when this event is the replay of a prior successful idempotency_key (same operation_id and heads).

signatureAlgorithm.description: Host signing algorithm. Production hosts use ed25519 (phase 7). none is allowed only for offline fixtures and unsigned fake harnesses — never for durable production ledger entries that advertise signed history.

operationSignature.description: Host signature over the canonicalized unsigned event envelope (phase 7 defines canonicalization). Fixtures use shape-valid placeholder values. BFF and clients MUST treat signature as host-produced; never accept browser-forged signatures as authority.

value.description: Signature bytes as unpadded base64 (or the literal 'unsigned' when alg is none).

signed_fields.description: Optional explicit field list included in the signature payload. When omitted, host default canonical set applies (phase 7).

parents.description: Causal parent operation_id values. Empty array for the first event in a chain. Concurrent writers may produce multi-parent merges later; v1 fixtures are mostly single-parent linear chains. Parents do not replace DocumentRevision CAS.

signedOperationEvent.description: Append-only signed ledger event. Authoritative history unit. Does not replace vault.write request/result frames; those remain the mutation API. Hosts append this after ACL/CAS verification (phase 4/7).

instance_id.description: Backend instance that observed/committed the operation.

occurred_at.description: Host time when the operation was committed or rejected.

body_hash.description: Present when the operation carried body bytes (committed write or rejected attempt that hashed a body). Omitted for body-less rejects and pure metadata events.

idempotency_key.description: Caller vault.write idempotency_key when this event was produced by vault.write. Replays MUST return the same operation_id and heads.

vault_write_mode.description: vault.write mode that produced this event, when applicable.

advances_artifact_head.description: Explicit head-advance flag. true only when status=committed and the file head for target.path should move. Rejected events MUST be false.

advances_workspace_head.description: true when committed mutation changes the workspace tree root hash (path set or content map). Rejected events MUST be false.

meta.description: Optional non-authoritative tags (tool_call_id, request_id). additionalProperties allowed for forward-compatible host tags; never secrets.

artifactHead.description: Materialized current head for one vault path. Points at the latest committed signed operation and its DocumentRevision. Separate from operation history: heads move only on committed events with advances_artifact_head=true.

operation_id.description: Latest committed operation that advanced this path head.

revision.description: Current DocumentRevision for path — same object vault.stat / vault.write CAS use.

head_kind.description: canonical = normal vault path head. checkpoint = head of a checkpoint destination path (agent staged write).

source_path.description: When head_kind=checkpoint, the canonical path the agent intended.

actor.description: Optional last-writer actor summary for UI currentness.

workspaceHead.description: Materialized workspace currentness. tree_root_hash digests the ACL-visible path→revision map (exact canonicalization in phase 2/7). Advances when committed file create/replace/checkpoint/delete/rename change the map; rejected ops do not advance.

workspace_id.description: Workspace partition id. Use 'default' for single-workspace tenants.

tree_root_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical workspace tree fingerprint.

operation_id.description: Latest committed operation that advanced this workspace head.

entry_count.description: Number of file entries in the fingerprint when known.
